findings.claim: killed, hung, or buffer-overflowing commands delivered no verdict yet were recorded as RED pins: real Node reports e.status null (never undefined) and the 1MB default maxBuffer turned passing verbose commands into fake REDs (lanes 1/4/6 proved it live)
grandfathered records stand as counterexamples and the fence never re-checked the pin law: gap-hardening sits at done with path-only evidence while the docs claim the arc is machine-verified
the done refusal named pin-exempt, which the done path ignores — an operator following the remedy stays blocked; only pin-retire unblocks and it was never named

pin re-runs executed inside the task lock where a 300s pin outlives the 60s stale-breaker, gifting concurrent writers the lost-update bug the lock exists to prevent; pins also ran before cheap phase refusals
pin-retire and pin-exempt were self-granted in any phase, even after done, with one-character justifications
recorded pins were believed wholesale: forged exit-0 and killed-null exitCodes passed the verified gate
the swept range pinned a moving alias (HEAD) and hashed the diff's stat shape, not its content; old registers carry no swept fields at all
WIRING.md still taught the demoted path-only law and pin-exempt/pin-retire were documented nowhere
status/obligations reported done as unblocked without mentioning the pin re-runs that advance will perform
retired pins' evidence paths still fed the on-disk evidence check, an unremediable refusal path
the banner counted 9 remedy cases while enumerating 10
the 300s timeout kills only the sh child; background grandchildren survive as orphans
findings.justification: pins are test commands, not daemons; process-group kill on timeout is registered future work — the boundary is documented and the no-verdict refusal already fails closed.

findings.claim: the wave's only surviving pin is the tool's own self-test: the harness grading itself, circular for self-changes
findings.justification: harness self-changes can only pin their own battery; the pin did discriminate (exit 1 pre-fix, 0 post-fix) and host-repo tasks pin real suites. Circular-but-honest is the documented boundary.

findings.claim: evidence paths accept absolute paths outside the repo and resolve cwd-first, so a same-named file anywhere validates
findings.justification: repo-confinement and cwd-ordering of evidence paths are the documented plain-trust boundary, shared with the RED-check law; tightening lands with issue #8's binding design.
